neighbours.label: the word just before a connection participle (is bonded, get involved, closely tied, intimately linked)
fire: There are many ways that parents can get involved in the school.
Language is closely tied to a sense of identity.
Each carbon atom is bonded to four hydrogen atoms.
The two crises were intimately connected from the start.
The ministry became more directly involved in the talks.
Diet and sleep are tightly linked in young children.
Volunteers who want to get involved should email the club.
His fortunes were closely bound up with those of the king.
quiet: There are many ways that parents can help out at the school.
Language is an important part of a sense of identity.
Each carbon atom has four hydrogen atoms around it.
The two crises began at almost the same moment.
